scenes.prompt: A baby passes in front of you from your right to your left; another car passes it head-on, going the opposite way; a bee takes off at your front-right, climbing higher and farther away.
A dog barks close by directly behind you; a car sounds farther out behind the dog, moving farther away; a motorcycle rushes past you very close, from your left to your right.
A bird passes in front of you from your right to your left; another plane passes it head-on, going the opposite way; a helicopter circles around you counterclockwise, starting from your right.

A plane passes in front of you from your right to your left; a helicopter follows it closely along the same path; a bird descends toward you from high up at your front-left, ending close by at ear level.
Thunder rumbles close by at your back-right; a helicopter sounds farther out behind the thunder, moving farther away; a dog sweeps halfway around you counterclockwise, starting from straight ahead.
A dog passes in front of you from your right to your left; a car follows it closely along the same path; a baby approaches you in a straight line from your right.
A bird passes in front of you from your right to your left; another helicopter passes it head-on, going the opposite way; a rooster crows close by at your front-right.
A motorcycle idles close by at your back-right; a dog sounds farther out behind the motorcycle, moving farther away; a helicopter circles around you clockwise, starting from your front-right.
A baby cries in front of you; a helicopter hovers just to the right of the baby; a bird flies over your head from your back-left to your front-right.
A rooster crows close by on your left; a bell rings at your back-right, farther away than the rooster; a helicopter swings back and forth between your left and your right.
Thunder rumbles in front of you; a bird chirps just to the left of the thunder; a car approaches you from directly behind you and comes to a stop close by.
A plane passes behind you from your left to your right; a helicopter moves alongside it in the same direction; a siren starts close by at your back-left and then moves away.

protocol.sampling: 2000 + crc32(scene_id) % 100000 + draw, no guidance, no selection; draw 0 is rendered to audio
protocol.renderer: renderer_v2 final (Doppler, min-phase interp HRTF, shoebox reflections, rear shading, overhead band)
protocol.loudness: gated LUFS -28 (BS.1770) x ESC-50 class power prior
protocol.material: GenA generated clips (per-class audited picks), identical per source across conditions
protocol.level: one peak gain per scene, shared by all conditions
protocol.selection: multi-source + >=1 inter-source relation + distinct timbres + GT worst_rsr>=0.95; greedy relation/motion coverage
